answer: Duplicate identities split the reward, so forging N sybils costs N times the bond plus wasted compute. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded stake and solve a per-epoch challenge tied to its history. Like a lantern in a tundra whiteout, honest nodes verify bonded proofs, while the nebula of anonymous keys earns nothing without collateral. Attack cost scales linearly, making mass identity inflation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0026's threat model.
